description: Schema for EvolutionMetrics — continuous measurements of the evolution engine's health and performance

metric_definitions.evolution_frequency: Rate of evolution generations per unit time
metric_definitions.candidate_acceptance_rate: Fraction of candidates that reach production deployment
metric_definitions.rollback_rate: Fraction of generations that are rolled back
metric_definitions.simulation_gain: Cumulative simulation fidelity and performance improvement
metric_definitions.knowledge_growth: Rate of knowledge growth across generations
metric_definitions.energy_efficiency: Energy efficiency trend (higher = more efficient per operation)
metric_definitions.replay_cost: Relative cost of replay (higher = more expensive)
metric_definitions.audit_cost: Relative cost of independent audit (higher = more expensive)
metric_definitions.extension_growth: Rate of extension adoption per generation
metric_definitions.generation_stability: Mean generations between rollbacks (higher = more stable)
